snapshot.reason: Public Bank Berhad has proposed to privatize Public Financial Holdings Limited via a scheme of arrangement, leading to a withdrawal of its listing.
snapshot.why_now: Trading in the shares is resuming following the joint privatization announcement on September 8, 2026.
source_headlines: PUBLIC FIN HOLD (00626): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT (1) PROPOSED PRIVATISATION OF PUBLIC FINANCIAL HOLDINGS LIMITED BY PUBLIC BANK BERHAD BY WAY OF A SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT UNDER SECTION 99 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 1981 OF BERMUDA (AS AMENDED FROM TIME TO TIME); (2) PROPOSED WITHDRAWAL OF LISTING OF SHARES OF PUBLIC FINANCIAL HOLDINGS LIMITED; AND (3) RESUMPTION OF TRADING IN THE SHARES
